title: Nano Banana 2 ile 9:16 bir referans concept sheet (armor design) üretip bunu…
content:
Nano Banana 2 ile 9:16 bir referans concept sheet (armor design) üretip bunu Seedance 2.0’a image olarak yükleyerek 15 sn / 16:9 cinematic transformation videosu üret.  
Görseli prompt içinde tarif etmek yerine Seedance 2.0’da reference image olarak ver; armor tutarlılığı ve renk doğruluğu belirgin şekilde artar.

en.content:
Produce a 9:16 reference concept sheet (armor design) with Nano Banana 2 and upload it as an image to Seedance 2.0 to create a 15-second / 16:9 cinematic transformation video.  
Instead of describing the visual in the prompt, provide it as a reference image in Seedance 2.0; the consistency of the armor and color accuracy will significantly improve.
